prompt: Set $A$: $5, 6, 7$. Set $B$: $1, 6, 11$. Which has greater spread?
hint: Spread describes how far apart the values in a set are. Both sets here have the same middle value, $6$.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Draw a tiny dot plot. The shape of the data tells you which statistic to use.
Spread describes how far apart the values in a set are. Both sets here have the same middle value, $6$.
Compare the ranges. Set $A$ runs from $5$ to $7$, and set $B$ runs from $1$ to $11$. Subtract for each set.
The range of $A$ is $2$ and the range of $B$ is $10$, so set B has the greater spread.

explanation: One simple way to measure spread is the range, the largest value minus the smallest.
Set $A$ has range $7 - 5 = 2$, so its values stay close to $6$.
Set $B$ has range $11 - 1 = 10$, so its values reach much farther from $6$.
Since $10 > 2$, set $B$ has the greater spread, which is choice B.
